summary: 1 film announcement, 1 TV announcement across 3 trades.

film.title: Grown Ups 3
film.announcement: Production has begun on the third installment of the Grown Ups franchise, with Adam Sandler reuniting with co-stars as confirmed by set photos.

tv.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
